outcome: maternal quality of life (WHOQOL-BREF scores across physical health, psychological health, social relationships, and environment domains)
cohort: The study included 58 mothers who delivered between 22 0/7 and 25 6/7 weeks gestational age at a single institution from 2013 to 2019.
finding: Mothers with surviving infants reported higher quality of life in psychological health and social relationships domains compared to mothers whose infants experienced intrauterine or neonatal demise, though overall quality of life was not different.
followup_time: 5.1 +/- 2.0 years for mothers with surviving infants and 4.5 +/- 2.1 years for mothers with demise, from delivery to study start date.
